observations.trace: The CLI exposes party_reconnect_grace as an f32 without a local zero guard; apply_enemy_fixture leaves it unchanged. Zero converts to Duration::ZERO and MissionState retains it. On a running terminal check, a loaded party member is observed and begins enrollment; a loading player also begins enrollment. PartyEnrollment resets empty_for to ZERO whenever loaded_party is nonzero or a player is loading, then compares empty_for >= reconnect_grace even in that present/loading case. With zero grace this returns Abandoned. The caller freezes a Failed terminal result and initiates submission or the standalone local result path.
observations.remaining: This is source-level conditional reasoning only. No CLI, timer, actor, mission, app, database, reducer, network, result or product ran. Awaiting enrollment with neither observed nor loading party returns before the comparison. Future policy must decide whether zero is rejected or means immediate abandonment only for an actually empty party, preserving loading/reconnect and durable authority.
